Introducing Saved Views, available today for all customers on paid plans. Keeping track of the filters, sorting, and grouping you rely on every day shouldn't take extra effort — now it doesn't. With Saved Views, you can capture any custom configuration of a list and return to it instantly, without rebuilding it each time.

Each user can save up to 50 views, so you can set up dedicated views for sprints, priorities, clients, or anything else your workflow demands. Need your team on the same page? Views can be shared with teammates, giving everyone quick access to the exact setup you've configured, whether it's a filtered backlog, a weekly status list, or a custom dashboard for stakeholders.

Saved Views works across every list in your workspace and updates automatically as your data changes, so what you see is always current. It's a small addition that removes a lot of repetitive setup from your daily routine.

Open any list and select Save view to get started.
